sections.title: The letter zède
paragraphs: The letter name is (zède) /zɛd/. Its main sound is heard in the word (zèbre) /zɛbʁ/, which means zebra. This letter has one spoken sound in French, but it can also stay quiet.

sections.title: Pronouncing the letter
paragraphs: Bring the tip of your tongue close to the ridge behind your upper teeth. Blow air through the small gap to make a buzz. Turn your voice on. Touch your throat to feel the strong vibration of this sound.

sections.title: Spelling rules
paragraphs: At the start of a word or between vowels, you say this sound as in (zone) /zon/. At the end of many common words, this letter is a silent letter and you do not pronounce it, as in (nez) /ne/ or (riz) /ʁi/.

sections.title: Common mistakes
paragraphs: Do not turn the sound off into an s sound like in bus. Keep your vocal cords buzzing steadily like the z in zero. When the letter ends a word, do not say it at all.
